title: This does not heat your coffee or tea
text: This does not heat your coffee or tea. I was disappointed by this product.  I bought it with the notion of heating tea.  It only helps maintain the temperature for drinks that are already hot.  I left it turned on for a couple hours and it only got the water luke warm.  If you are looking for something to make tea or coffee.  Look else where.  When I read the manufacturers pamphlet, it indicated it was not designed to heat drinks, but to help maintain the temperature.  I would have been better off running hot water from the tap and sticking a tea bag in it,
